notes.title: Shortlisted for the New Media Writing Prize 2021
notes.content:
I'm honored to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1267770/Linda__Joan_Prologue_Four_Months_Earlier/?utm_campaign=fixed&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=announcement][i]“Four Months Earlier”[/i][/url] was shortlisted for the [url=https://newmediawritingprize.co.uk/2021-shortlist/]New Media Writing Prize 2021![/url]

I was asked to provide a two-minute video to introduce the project:

[previewyoutube=t8GSd6KNW-A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

You can download [i]“Four Months Earlier”[/i] for free on macOS, and Windows!

It is a standalone prologue to a larger game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270760/Linda__Joan/?utm_campaign=fixed&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=announcement][i]Linda & Joan[/i][/url] that I am working on.

Learn more about the project — and join the ZINE CLUB! — here: [url=https://www.lindajoan.com]www.lindajoan.com[/url]

Thank you for your support!

—Russell

notes.title: Introducing… Linda & Joan Zine Club!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37266137/4728430314fd6e858cd303c00368849b64c9c57f.gif[/img]

[url=https://www.lindajoan.com/zine-club][b]Join Zine Club[/b][/url]! A companion project for the forthcoming video game [i]Linda & Joan[/i]. 

[list]
[*] Receive [b]ten handcrafted zines[/b] — each with bonus items — in the mail over the next year or so
[*] [b]Learn backstory[/b] about the real family that inspired the game [i]Linda & Joan[/i]
[*] Form a [b]deeper understanding[/b] of the characters, situations, and objects you’ll discover in the final game
[*] Use the zines [b]to solve in-game puzzles[/b] and play scenes only accessible to Zine Club members
[*] [b]Support independent art[/b] and the development of [i]Linda & Joan[/i]
[/list]

[url=https://www.lindajoan.com/zine-club][b][h1]>> [u]JOIN TODAY[/u] <<[/h1][/b][/url]

notes.title: Bonus Scene: “The Candle”
notes.content:
[i]“The Candle”[/i] is a new bonus scene available exclusively to members of the [i]Linda & Joan[/i] Mailing List.

This short experience is based on a poem that the real Linda Quinn wrote in the winter of 2004. 

Available for Windows and macOS.

Sign up to the mailing list for free here and get [i]“The Candle”[/i]:
https://www.lindajoan.com/the-candle

Thank you for your support,

—Russell

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is now available
notes.content:
Thank you for playing and for sending all the heartfelt messages! To hear it's connecting with people is wonderful!

[b]Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some dialogue typos;
[*] Made it easier to tell which way to go at the start;
[*] Other tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: “Four Months Earlier” will be released on July 14th!
notes.content:
[i]“Four Months Earlier”[/i] will be released on July 14th! This is part one of the [i]Linda & Joan[/i] story. It’s a free, standalone experience for Windows, macOS (and iOS).

[b]Wishlist on Steam today![/b]
